calls.title: Growthbook <> Product Hackers
calls.summary: The meeting focused on strengthening the partnership between Product Hackers and Growth Book, emphasizing mutual client growth and technical enablement. Product Hackers manages 30-40 clients with a strong retention rate, targeting sectors like e-commerce and insurance, and plans to integrate a European account executive, James, for better support. A formal training initiative will ensure that 10-20 of their technical team members are proficient with Growth Book’s platform, vital for improving client outcomes. The collaboration model is flexible, prioritizing client service over strict contracts, with an optional referral agreement. Additionally, there is a need to enhance Growth Book’s visibility in Europe, leveraging Product Hackers' strong content and events. Both teams value remote flexibility and clear communication to foster effective partnership and client service.
calls.keywords: Partnership, Training, Growth Book, Product Hackers, Client Management, Referral Agreement
calls.action_items:
**Ryan McGurk**
Send referral agreement to Product Hackers (19:45)
Follow up with Ana to schedule the Growth Book training session after new hire 'James' starts, expected mid to late February (18:45)
Introduce Ana to new London-based account executive once onboarded (14:40)

**Ana Pérez Calvo**
Coordinate internally to identify appropriate Growth Team members (~10-20) for Growth Book training and propose suitable times for scheduling (16:50)
Await Ryan’s email with agreement and training details to move forward (20:15)
